name: PROTEINS
description: A graph-classification dataset of protein structures from the TU Dortmund graph kernel benchmark collection. Each graph represents a protein, with vertices corresponding to secondary-structure elements and edges encoding spatial proximity; the graph label indicates whether the protein is an enzyme. This record catalogs the dataset and does not distribute data.
citation: Dobson, P. D., & Doig, A. J. (2003). Distinguishing enzyme structures from non-enzymes without alignments. Journal of Molecular Biology, 330(4), 771–783. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0022-2836(03)00376-1
